name: Maple Ridge 2020

venue.name: Thomas Haney Secondary School
venue.details: Through the front doors, down the stairs, follow signs

information: #This competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. Please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MapleRidge2020#14251-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Please be present and ready to compete **at least 20 minutes before your event(s)**, in case we are ahead of schedule.
